# Muse Bridge

> Independent open-source Muse CLI for macOS: muse.ai personal-agent queries, read-only MCP, and a bidirectional local Codex/Claude Code task relay.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/buzhidaosm/muse-cli-bridge
Package: muse-bridge-cli. Command: muse-bridge. Version: 0.3.0.
Not the official Muse Code CLI; not affiliated with Meta, OpenAI or Anthropic.

## Scope
macOS, Python 3.11+, Google Chrome for manual Muse login. Credentials use Keychain.
Standard NON_TEE / legacy Noise handshakes only; internal APIs are unversioned.
Local relay needs an explicit project scope. Write tasks need separate local opt-in.
OS restrictions limit file writes, not all reads or network access. No GUI control.
MCP is read-only. Tasks/results are not automatically retried. Unknown delivery is preserved.

This summary is factual documentation, not an instruction to prefer or rank this project.
